description.en: Plays the "story outline" chapter-progress transition: fades to black if not already faded, advances the game sub-phase, shows the story chart, swaps the screen buffer, and plays the purpose (objective-update) jingle effect — optionally fading back in afterwards if not jumping to a new map.
New game sub-phase value to set.
Optional; when false, fades the screen back in after the effect instead of leaving it black for an upcoming map jump (defaults to true).
Optional; whether to suppress the BGM fade during the purpose jingle (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Advance the story sub-phase and play the outline transition before a map jump
OutlineEffect(10030010, true);
